datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Chad on a monthly basis throughout 2015 (January, April, July, October). The classifications were spatially referenced and compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity phases at sub-national administrative units, providing temporal snapshots of acute food insecurity conditions.
